body: Seven years ago, Juice WRLD and NBA YoungBoy joined forces on “Bandit” and the song quickly became a major moment for both artists. Released on October 4, 2019, it peaked at No. 10 on the Billboard Hot 100, giving YoungBoy his first-ever top 10 hit. It also marked the second Hot 100 top 10 of Juice WRLD’s career, following “Lucid Dreams. ” Since then, “Bandit” has surpassed 1 billion Spotify streams, proving its staying power years after release.

source_caption_text:
Seven years ago, Juice WRLD and NBA YoungBoy joined forces on “Bandit” and the song quickly became a major moment for both artists. 

Released on October 4, 2019, it peaked at No. 10 on the Billboard Hot 100, giving YoungBoy his first-ever top 10 hit. It also marked the second Hot 100 top 10 of Juice WRLD’s career, following “Lucid Dreams.” 

Since then, “Bandit” has surpassed 1 billion Spotify streams, proving its staying power years after release. The track was produced by Nick Mira, whose work helped shape the melodic sound that connected the two artists’ styles. 

A huge collaboration, an unforgettable video, and a song that continues to bring Juice WRLD and YoungBoy fans together. 🕊️🔥 What’s your favorite part of “Bandit”?
